_description: ADDITIVE fixture (PR 3). The WebSocket auth_ok frame gains `features`: the capabilities of the server. `refs_v1` means a client may send `refs` (user_message frames, POST /api/chat/sessions, POST /api/chat/sessions/{id}/messages). The field is ABSENT (never an empty array) on a server that predates refs or has switched them off (REFS_V1=0): absent means 'do not send refs'. The REST twin, readable before any WebSocket exists, is GET /api/version -> features.refs_v1 (boolean).

ws_error_frame_for_refs_invalid._note: The WS `error` frame keeps `message` (older clients show it) and gains code/reason/index. REST uses the errors.json body (HTTP 400). forbidden is never emitted: a refused or failed lookup is not_found.
